protected_functions.description: Joel's direct 2026-08-24 correction: Somatic Experiencing, trauma-sensitive/restorative yoga, TRE/gentle shaking, EFT, Shaking Qigong, Brainspotting, EMDR, light CBT/narrative integration, Sky Hypnosis, and Vagal Blitz are therapy modalities or practices, not 'jobs'. Do not restore the five-job taxonomy or merely rename its boxes.

Preserve the useful timing distinctions without converting them into a formal stage model: regulation/capacity work can help before deeper processing when someone is easily overwhelmed; Brainspotting can fit diffuse/body-held or hard-to-narrate material; EMDR can fit a discrete memory or trigger network; cognitive integration can become easier after the body is less trapped in threat. Modalities may overlap and a stable person with a clear target may move to trauma-focused work earlier.
Preserve the warning that capacity-building should not become indefinite avoidance of actual trauma treatment.
Preserve the Nurturer/Protector, borrowed-adulthood, gentle self-hypnosis, and heart-to-solar-plexus love-loop material and its placement as overlap with somatic work.

Preserve supplied personal/material voice anchors including Professor Baby Sheep, Joel's head-shaving/massage experience with loveyhuasca, and Louka's report about the linked Shaking Qigong class unless Joel changes them.

Preserve the substantive safety boundaries: stop/return capacity, neck support during tremoring, non-coercive yoga, post-session integration, caution stacking intense modalities, and Sky Hypnosis/Vagal Blitz physical and mental-health cautions.

Preserve distinctions among published research, clinical practice, personal experience, community signal, traditional/energetic explanations, and proposed mechanisms, without repeatedly restating the same epistemic disclaimer when the reader already has it.
Preserve the eight native/editor objects, their exact identity/metadata, and source positions unless publication-source evidence or Joel authorizes a change.
